about_the_game:
“Don’t Look Back” recreates the fear of walking alone through dark alleys, lightless fields, and pitch-black forests.

There are no monsters chasing you, no ghosts hiding in the shadows. But never turn around.

In the darkness beyond your sight, something is surely watching you.

The game uses only mouse and W, A, S, D controls.

Simple, yet that very simplicity becomes the source of fear.

Estimated playtime: 15–20 minutes.
